mapping.consumer_evidence: scanline[x] = qRgb(palette[3 * idx + 2], palette[3 * idx + 1], palette[3 * idx + 0]);
mapping.reason: Admission is the IsSupported gate that accepts the RLE TGA header. Root is the readRawData call that can leave pixel uninitialized on truncation. Consumer is the palette index use that turns the uninitialized byte into a visible MSAN violation. Observations probe the read size, stream end state, and the uninitialized index.
